EPA GHG repeal boosts energy
I'll systematically scan the specified official sources for developments from the past two weeks, then map each item to the sector checklist.*1. Executive Summary*
The most market-relevant policy action in the past two weeks is EPA’s September 14, 2026 final partial repeal of the 2024 Carbon Pollution Standards for fossil fuel-fired power plants, paired with a proposal to strip remaining Clean Air Act Section 111 GHG standards for the sector. That is *supportive* for coal, gas generation, and utilities that still run thermal fleets, and *increased friction* for carbon-capture vendors and some renewables that had been priced as compliance substitutes.
